title: CashDeposit
description: A cash deposit recorded at a location.

deleted.description: Whether the deposit is marked as deleted.

amount.description: Deposit amount in US dollars, as a decimal string.

employeeId.description: Identifier of the employee who recorded the deposit.

jobPositionId.description: Job position of the employee during recording.

recordedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the deposit was recorded.

lastUpdatedByEmployeeId.description: Identifier of the employee who last updated the deposit.

lastUpdatedByJobPositionId.description: Job position of the employee during the last update.

lastUpdatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last update.
